title: ירושלים, מקווה טהרה בעיסוייה (Jerusalem, ʿIsawiya)
author: R. Reich (excavation); S. Gibson (survey)
notes: Later reuse (Late Roman or Byzantine) with a gabled cover over the lower part; a few bones and sherds in the covered space (not coded as a tomb: the report gives no function).

features.subtype: rock-cut plastered stepped installation with divided steps and twin entrances; excavator's label: Jewish miqveh
features.period: type in use in the 1st c. BCE and 1st c. CE (by parallels); no dating finds in place
features.quote: להגדירו כמיקווה טהרה ,יהודי מטיפוס טהיה בטימוט במאה

title: ירושלים, איזור כביש ירושלים - מעלה אדומים (Jerusalem - Maʿale Adummim road area)
author: G. Edelstein
location_note: Near ʿIsawiya. Both printed map references are written northing first (13440/17430, 13410/17440); used here as 17430/13440 and 17440/13410 (INFERENCE).

features.site: A: agricultural units above Nahal Salim
features.subtype: rectangular rock-cut plastered cistern with built mouth, still in use
features.period: not dated (buildings with First Temple, Persian and early Hellenistic sherds)

features.subtype: small cave probably used to quarry stone for the terraces
features.quote: ששימשה כנראה לחציבת אבן לבניית הרבדות

features.subtype: cave (6 x 12 m) with five rock-cut steps, probably for dwelling or storage
rock-cut pit 4 m wide with four rows of small niches; excavator: probably a columbarium
features.period: unclear; fill with First Temple sherds

features.subtype: several rock-cut pools, the largest plastered (7.5 x 4.7 m); function unknown per report
features.period: late First Temple jar and juglet on the floor of one pool

features.subtype: rock-cut channel descending from the large pool

title: ירושלים, רמות (Jerusalem, Ramot, burial cave)
author: A. Kloner
location_note: Ramot; the printed map reference (16828/31612) is garbled in the copy and not used.

features.subtype: square chamber with blocking stone in place, standing pit, benches, kokhim, four ossuaries; 10-12 individuals
features.period: 1st century (OCR of the era unclear; BCE or CE)
features.quote: והמימצא מורה על שימושה במאה האי

title: ירושלים, הר ציון (Jerusalem, Mount Zion)
author: B. Pixner, D. Chen, S. Margalit

features.subtype: public drainage channel (12 m exposed), lined with plastered fieldstones and, near the gate, large ashlars

title: ירושלים, עמק רפאים (Jerusalem, ʿEmeq Rephaim)
author: G. Edelstein, S. Gibson
location_note: Southern slopes of Giv'at Massu'a; no map reference.
notes: MB I settlement layer, walls and a built stone installation of unknown use; later agricultural terraces. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים, מזרח תלפיות (Jerusalem, East Talpiyot)
author: A. Kloner, Y. Gat
location_note: Three items: A (1719/1283), B (1724/1288), C (no map reference).
notes: Cisterns and installations near cave B are cited from HA 76 (earlier work, not coded).

features.subtype: burial cave with heavy blocking stone, benches, standing pit, kokhim and small niches; about 20 ossuaries, inscriptions in Hebrew and Greek
features.period: end of the 1st c. BCE and 1st c. CE
features.quote: שהמערה שימשה בסוף המאה האי לפסה״נ ובמאה האי

features.subtype: burial cave with square closing stone in place, standing pit, nine kokhim, seven decorated ossuaries
features.period: 1st c. CE, probably from the end of the 1st c. BCE
features.quote: מערת קבורה מימי בית שני נתגלתה במזרח תלפיות

features.subtype: central rock-cut and built cistern (c. 7.5 m diam., 8 m deep) and plastered cisterns
features.period: pottery mostly Byzantine, also Late and Early Roman, Hellenistic, a few Iron Age
features.quote: כנראה בור ,מים חצוב ,בסלע ובנוי בחלקו העליון

features.subtype: plastered channels (one covered), regulating installation and two clay pipes
square plastered pool (2 x 2 m) lined with ashlars, slab floor and sump
features.period: cooking-pot sherds of the Second Temple period inside
features.quote: המימצא בבריכה כלל שברי סירי בישול מימי בית
